_comment: Measured for the SVELTE stack on 2026-08-26, with roughly 15% headroom — the same basis as the React budgets, not a copy of their values. The shape differs on purpose: this stack's HOSTS are far smaller (no framework in the host at all) and its REMOTES are larger, because Svelte's runtime cannot be shared across a federation boundary and every remote carries a private copy. See docs/svelte-federation.md. Raising a budget is a reviewed commit with a reason.
